about_short_description.short_description: FortyGuard provides associated solutions related to environmental and energy data and are expert in outdoor temperature smart location data.

product.name: Temperature Dashboard®
product.description: A cloud-based platform providing real-time, historical, and predictive urban temperature data with high-resolution maps and analytics for urban heat management.

product.name: Temperature Realtor®
product.description: A tool that provides location-specific temperature intelligence reports based on input coordinates without requiring heatmap interaction.

product.name: Temperature API®
product.description: An API service delivering real-time, historical, and predictive temperature data for integration into external platforms and applications.

product.name: Advisory Services
product.description: Consulting services offering advanced temperature solutions and real-time heat monitoring for areas with limited data access.

product.name: Temperature Twin®
product.description: A cloud-based AI-driven 3D digital twin platform for real-time urban heat monitoring, analysis, and predictive temperature modeling.

product.name: Temperature Dashboard
product.description: A free dashboard from FortyGuard that provides localized, street-level temperature intelligence for users.
